title: Evidence-Graph Entity Ingestion Helpers Shared by Runners
goal: Implement a thin shared helper module that runners call to register structured graph entities (asset, identity, credential_ref, endpoint, finding) and relationships during execution, so the normalized graph accumulates first-class entities rather than being reconstructed from stdout heuristics.
scope: Create api/app/services/evidence_ingest.py (or equivalent) exposing a stable contract that runners can import to emit graph fragments. Wire it through build_normalized_evidence_graph so emitted fragments merge correctly with existing source-graph nodes. Migrate 3-5 high-value runners identified in the audit (#321) as pilot consumers.
generation_reason: Audit task #321 will identify that most runners produce evidence only via stdout strings + JSON artifacts. Without a shared ingestion helper, every runner reinvents how to write entities into the graph, causing inconsistent provenance and confidence handling.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Helper module + pilot integration in 3-5 runners only. Do NOT migrate every runner here. Do NOT change the picker (that is task #323).
constraints.additive_only: Helper must be additive. Existing runners that do not opt in continue to work via the source-graph reconstruction path.

success_criteria: New shared module exists with a typed contract for emitting (entity_type, entity_id, attributes, provenance) and (source_id, target_id, relationship, confidence) records.
build_normalized_evidence_graph merges directly-emitted entities with the existing source-graph nodes without duplicates.
3-5 pilot runners (selection driven by audit #321) call the helper and write at least one structured entity per execution.
Existing runner tests pass without modification for non-pilot runners.
New unit tests prove helper round-trips entities through the graph and merges with existing nodes.

acceptance_criteria: Helper emits entities that appear in build_normalized_evidence_graph output without duplication.
At least 3 runners produce structured entities during integration tests.
No regression in existing graph normalization tests.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.

out_of_scope: Migrating all 75 runners in this task.
New node or edge types beyond what build_normalized_evidence_graph already supports.
